cohort: 244 pregnant women hospitalized during the year 2020 with SARS-CoV-2
finding: Most pregnant women had an IgG IgM serologic result, and the most frequent obstetric complications were premature rupture of membranes and preterm delivery.
mod_finding: 74.6% had vaginal delivery, 18% had a cesarean section, 4.1% did not have an institutional delivery, and 3.3% of the pregnant women had an abortion.
